Identified as this saint because: Commons names the Menologion of Basil II miniature for Acindynus, Pegasias, Aphthonius, Anempodistus, Elpidephorus and the seven thousand — the Persian company kept on 2 November, which is this folder's Greek feast. Aphthonius is shown among them, not alone. Commons describes it: Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
